warning Educational Note: The do-while Loop

This code uses a do...while loop. This means the code inside the loop executes at least once before checking the condition. A potential issue here is that EOF (End of File) is processed inside the loop body before the check, which might count the EOF marker itself as a character depending on the system. A safer pattern is typically while ((c = fgetc(fp)) != EOF).
